name: EB-3 Visa Bulletin — September 2026 Update
author: flint-editorial-team
excerpt: The September 2026 Visa Bulletin holds EB-3 Final Action Dates steady from August. See cutoff dates for India, China, the Philippines and more.

main-image.alt: Headline '2026 EB-3 Update' on a cream background with blue and red shapes

quick-answer: The September 2026 Visa Bulletin keeps all EB-3 Final Action Dates unchanged from August. The cutoff is September 1, 2024 for All Chargeability Areas Except Those Listed and Mexico, January 1, 2022 for China, January 1, 2014 for India, and August 1, 2023 for the Philippines. Compared with the July bulletin, only the Rest of World/Mexico and China dates moved forward; India and the Philippines remain unchanged. USCIS requires employment-based adjustment applicants to use the Final Action Dates chart for September 2026.
